column1: # quest_template_locale: this backlog is now EMPTY. All 5 original entries resolved 2026-07-12.
# 13843 (The Scrapbot Construction Kit): a stray pending_db_world override was blanking
# out this quest's Title/Details/Objectives even though base/db_world already had
# complete, well-formed zhTW text for all three -- same regression class as the
# quest-11987 fix earlier in this branch. Deleting the override restored the existing
# base translation; quest is now fully resolved.
# Delivery), 13184 (Outliving Usefulness): same stray-override bug restored their
# Title from base. Checked whether the remaining blank Details/Objectives/EndText/etc
# still needed manual translation -- they don't: the ENGLISH base quest_template row
# has every body field blank too (LogDescription/QuestDescription/AreaDescription/
# QuestCompletionLog all ''), and Wowhead's own wotlk-build page (wowhead.com/wotlk/
# quest=<id>) confirms these are real, non-deprecated WotLK content with no flavor
# text of its own either -- Wowhead's page description is just its generic
# "A level N <Zone> Quest. Rewards ." template, not real quest text. These are
# "title-only" quests by design (Storm Peaks/Icecrown, level 79-80); there is no
# source material in any language to translate. Considered fully resolved.
